# Constraint weights (gradient-size calibration, spec section 3)

Warm-started 16-class diffusion (/kaggle/input/notebooks/venkatesh007c/floorplan-finetune-constraints/runs/finetune_constraints/checkpoints/best.pt), 50 batches x 8 real training windows (GPU), t uniform 0-400, constraint losses gated by g(t) and in their training modes (G2). G = || dL / d x0_pred ||, median over the batches with signal (G_i > 0). w_i = rho * G_0 / G_i with rho = 0.0222 (= min(0.05, 0.4 / 18)); signal in < 10 batches -> median weight of the others; every weight capped at 10 x the median weight.
